integrity: The proof is an exact count from published linearly independent normal forms and a complete central-polynomial classification. Finite arithmetic checks are supporting evidence only. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The theorem treats only the non-order-two elementary grading branch in characteristic zero. An older equivalent count may be implicit in central-polynomial normal forms under different notation.
title: Proper central codimensions in the non-order-two elementary \(M_2\) branch
